principle: A declared identifier is provenance only. Authorization requires a distinct authenticated GitHub principal, least privilege, path scope, and owner-controlled protected gates.
activation_prerequisites: Replace every placeholder principal and installation_id with values observed from GitHub APIs.
Revoke agent access to the owner's human credential and verify that agents authenticate only as distinct GitHub Apps.
Protect gh-pages with required checks, stale-review dismissal and owner CODEOWNER approval.
Protect the production environment with the owner as required reviewer and prevent self-review.
Move production credentials to the protected environment and keep them unavailable to acquisition CI.
Audit and approve the canonical publisher workflow allowlist.

owner_authorization.merge: APPROVED review by owner login on the exact current head SHA, enforced by protected branch with stale approvals dismissed
owner_authorization.deploy: manual approval in protected production environment by owner; self-review disabled; branch restricted
owner_authorization.credentials: owner-only UI or owner-only principal; never an agent token

current_limitations: All current agent writes appear under the owner's GitHub identity, so provider identity is not authenticated.
session_ declarations remain documentary provenance and cannot authorize an executor.
This proposal must fail closed until distinct principals and protected controls are observable.
